title: Guides: how FA plays
text: Vehicle damage, penetration, cover, income, scoring, air defence and ECM, explained with pictures.
text_zh: 载具伤害、穿深、掩体、收入、计分、防空与电子干扰，图解说明。

title: Patch notes
text: Every change in each playtest, unit by unit, with old and new values.
text_zh: 每次测试版本的全部改动，逐个单位列出新旧数值。

title: Armory, DPM, prices
text: Compare any unit or weapon, damage per minute and deck prices in your browser.
text_zh: 在浏览器中比较任意单位或武器、每分钟伤害和卡组价格。

title: Roadmap
text: What we are building next, in order, up to the open beta.
text_zh: 我们接下来按顺序要做的内容，直到公开测试。

title: Ranked and live stats
text: Ranked 1v1 and team queues, Elo, the ladder and live statistics.
text_zh: 排位 1v1 与团队匹配、Elo、排行榜和实时统计。

title: Join our Discord
text: Find players, report bugs and help build Freedom Arrow. We are looking for volunteers.
text_zh: 找队友、报告问题、一起开发自由之箭。我们正在招募志愿者。
